primaryModel.primaryEstimator: prespecified mixed-effects model with superblock pairing
primaryModel.nonconvergenceFallback: same fixed-effect formula with superblock-cluster-robust covariance

confirmatoryFamily.D1IntersectionUnion: for each comparator, domain p-value is max of geometric-mean and P95 one-sided p-values; both simultaneous intervals must be entirely below ratio 1
confirmatoryFamily.D2ToD4NullBoundary: ratio or ratio-like contrast equals 1 on the declared scale
confirmatoryFamily.domainPass: valid hard gates plus all four target-versus-domain-gate-comparator hypotheses rejected after Holm with favorable direction and simultaneous intervals
confirmatoryFamily.cFFRole: formally tested non-gating comparator; retain estimate, interval, adjusted p-value, MIPE flag, pass status, and concrete failure explanation when not passed
confirmatoryFamily.primaryClaimPass: at least four of seven domains pass

mipeInterpretation.mandatoryReporting: For every IDFF-comparator domain contrast, report estimate, interval, adjusted p-value, direction, MIPE flag, and hypothesis pass status.

secondaryReporting.fullFifteenPairMatrices: exploratory, separately multiplicity controlled, never ordered or ranked

hardGates.correctnessOracle: all frozen path-status, version, legality, and reference-oracle checks retained
hardGates.gateFailureAfterCollection: affected domain remains in denominator and cannot support the majority claim
